appearances.snippet: He doesn't believe that. By the way, Jason Chaffetz, he's been honest about his background. His parents are in the government. They're literally in the FBI. So he's telling you that shot was closer. So what gives? Also, why is everybody telling lies?

verification.notes: False. Biographical reporting identifies Chaffetz’s father John as a businessman and his mother Peggy as the operator of a photography business, not FBI employees. His paternal grandfather Maxwell Chaffetz was the FBI special agent. The episode statement appears to have confused his parents with his grandfather.

records.text: Chaffetz said that, if he had to guess while events were still raw, the shot appeared to come from close proximity straight ahead.
records.speaker: Jason Chaffetz

appearances.snippet: Being there, seeing it within proximity, it seemed like it was a close shot. ... And so you couldn't be right above where you were at. But if I had to guess—and again, it's still raw—but if I had to guess and give a police statement right here, right now today—see where that water is?—it looked to me like it was in close proximity straight ahead, right in that area. If I had to guess, again...

verification.notes: Fox's contemporaneous interview and AP's same-day report confirm that Jason Chaffetz described the shot as seeming close and said he had the sense it came straight at Kirk. The statement properly preserves his tentative eyewitness framing rather than treating it as a forensic conclusion.
